result.factsMarkdown:
# Facts

- Both CLI and server paths via a shared retrieval layer.
- Role-boundary exchanges with parent/child chunking.
- Each chunk carries phase, significance, why_context, and related_to metadata.
- At ingest time, immediately when messages are ingested/synced.
- Option C: Annotated chunks + dynamic query (analysis instructions + session summary + related past insights).
- Threshold-based: above ~80% of model context window.
- Hybrid B+C: window augmentation (compact summary + position tag) + neighbor inclusion (±1 adjacent chunks).
- Separate pass with sampled summary (existing pattern). Facets stay output-only.
- Soft gate: compute embeddings in parallel, analysis waits only if not ready by LLM call time.
- Block until embeddings are ready.
- New table vec_analysis_chunks, separate from vec_messages.
